title: a fully mechanical node closes with zero judge invocation
proves: pins the behavior the unit test D24 ('a three-node replayed contract without judgment items closes with zero judge invocations') already establishes: judgeRequired in judge-gate.mjs is false when no Definition of Done item carries judgment: true, so a gated node whose only DoD item carries a mechanical proof settles from runMechanicalProofs alone and never dispatches the judge runtime at all — not even to have it decline. The node's own runtimeIds therefore names only the worker.

contract.goal: prove a purely mechanical Definition of Done closes without a judge invocation
